claims.text: A car pulls forward out of the dark.
The action takes place on an open, unlit paved area with blackness on all sides and a faint pool of pale light ahead of the car.
The car is a conventional passenger vehicle with a hood and windshield; its panels and glass stay dark until the front enters the light.
No people, signs, or other vehicles are present in the scene.
The supplied audio reference is a low engine rumble.

subjects.description: A car, seen first as a dark silhouette and then resolving as it advances into faint light.

references.description: The supplied low engine rumble, used as the engine sound effect.
references.retention_details: Use only as the engine sound effect; the supplied audio coverage is partial, so do not treat it as a complete acoustic bed.

soundscape: A low engine rumble, supplied by the audio reference, idles in the opening and swells as the car advances. No other sound is established.

description.text: faces the camera, its outline barely separable from the black; no road edge, horizon, or background detail is yet readable. The black is not pure flat: faint tonal shifts suggest a wide, unlit open area, but no landmark fixes its size or distance. The car holds in place, a low mass with a roofline that only just catches the eye against the surrounding dark. Its body stays almost entirely unreadable, with the hood, glass, and ground merging into the same deep shadow. There is no other object, figure, or light source to organize the space, so the darkness reads as an enclosing field rather than a visible room. Over the first seconds, the silhouette firms up only slightly, letting the viewer register the direction the car faces and the narrow margin between its outline and the black around it.

pulls forward out of the darkness. Its shape resolves gradually as it advances: first the front mass, then the hood and windshield separate from the black, and the body grows larger and more solid in the frame. A faint pool of pale light ahead catches the leading surfaces, giving the car a readable edge without revealing the whole setting. The light is weak and localized, not a bright reveal; it grazes the front edge and leaves the rest of the body dark. The ground beneath stays smooth, dark pavement, and the space beyond the light remains closed in black. No people, signs, or other vehicles appear. The movement is the main change: the silhouette becomes a vehicle with visible surfaces, and the surrounding darkness recedes just enough to show the car entering the faintly lit area.
